lines: Nestled in Denver's coveted Curtis Park Historic District, this Beautiful home offers a captivating fusion of historic charm and contemporary living. Step inside and discover a light-filled open floor plan, accentuated by soaring ceilings on all three levels. The gourmet kitchen boasts sleek modern appliances, including a gas cooktop, pot filler, and convenient in-island microwave. Relaxing on the inviting front porch, and fenced corner lot. in this spacious and serene space.

fullDescription.heading: The space
lines: Denver’s Curtis park Gem

Welcome to your perfect Denver home base – a beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom house tucked into the charming, tree-lined streets of historic Curtis Park, the heart of downtown Denver’s most walkable and vibrant neighborhood.

Step inside and feel instantly at home: soaring ceilings, hardwood floors, an open-concept living space flooded with natural light, and a chef’s kitchen that makes morning coffee or late-night tacos equally enjoyable. Three spacious bedrooms mean everyone gets privacy and comfort – after a Broncos, Avalanche, Nuggets, Rockies game or a concert.

Location doesn’t get better than this. You’re just blocks from RiNo’s buzzing arts district, Larimer Square’s rooftop bars, and some of Denver’s top-rated restaurants (think Beckon, Uchi, Dio Mio, and endless craft breweries). On game day, it’s an easy walk or quick rideshare to:
•	Empower Field at Mile High (Broncos games!)
•	Ball Arena (Nuggets, Avalanche, and the biggest touring concerts)
•	Coors Field (Rockies baseball and summer fireworks)

Spend your mornings sipping coffee on the front porch watching the neighborhood wake up, your afternoons exploring the city parks and galleries, and your evenings strolling to dinner and nightlife – then come home to a quiet, residential street where you can actually relax and get a great night’s sleep.

Whether you’re in town for a Broncos weekend, a concert series, a family getaway, or just to experience everything Denver has to offer, this house is the ideal launchpad – stylish, comfortable, and perfectly located so you can live like a local while having downtown Denver at your doorstep.
Book now – this Curtis Park gem gets snapped up fast, especially on game weekends and during festival season!

details.houseRulesNotes:
BUILDING HOA RENTAL RULES 
 
1.	Smoking or vaping (electronic cigarettes) is NOT allowed.  Should smoking occur, you could be charged damages of up to $500. 
2.	People other than those in the Guest party set forth above may not stay overnight in the property.  Any other person in the property is the sole responsibility of Guest. 
3.	All of the units are privately owned; the Homeowners are not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the premises or its facilities. The Homeowners are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the guest. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that all guests are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the premises or others whom they invite to use the premise. 
 
4.	Keep the property and all furnishings in good order. 
5.	Only use appliances for their intended uses. 
6.	Pets must be approved   
7.	Parking: 
PARKING – Parking is limited to one (1) vehicle in the space marked #1909.  Vehicle should be parked in designated parking areas only. Parking in any other space may result in towing; applicable fines/towing fees are the sole responsibility of the vehicle owner.  Metered parking on the street or in surface lots near the property is an option, but not recommended.   
 
8.	Housekeeping:  There is no daily housekeeping service. While linens and bath towels are included in the unit, daily maid service is not included in the rental rate.  We do not permit towels or linens to be taken from the units.  
9.	Fitness Area,  Use at your own risk.  No glass containers of any kind shall be permitted in these areas.  All persons using these areas shall abide by the rules posted therein. 
10.	Fireplace: fires are NOT permitted at any time.  
11.	Water: DO NOT FLUSH anything other than toilet paper.  No feminine products should be flushed at any time.  If it is found that feminine products have been flushed and clog the plumbing system, you could be charged damages of up to $1,000. 
12.	Storms:  No refunds will be given for storms. We do not refund due to road conditions. 
13.	Water shut-off:  No refunds will be given for temporary water or electrical shutoff due to building maintenance or emergency repairs. 
14.	Noise:  Guests shall exercise reasonable care to avoid loud or disturbing noises.
